review.why: Judged as a production-led public website rather than a Lab layout clone, this is a convincing Frame Shift transfer. The task-specific material changes, real app frames, intact creative and offset monetary planes establish TapMart rather than a generic marketplace or agency. The hero explains the proposition quickly, and the business section clearly separates campaigns from monthly content. Visible production navigation, actions, amounts and states remain recognizable; there is no apparent fabricated payout or automatic acceptance. The remaining gaps are concentrated: Get paid loses its working-product evidence, some frames lack complete native inspection/provenance coverage, and a few pricing treatments contradict the claimed cleanup.
review.verdict: Frame Shift’s foundation and TapMart’s real product story transferred well, but this phone pass needs targeted financial-demonstration and inspection fixes before release sign-off.
